key_structures: East-facing seven-tier Raja Gopura with seven ridge kalashas
Entrance with Vinayaka and wall-mounted Anjaneya
Flagstaff, Devi footprints and small Nandi
Navaranga, Antarala, west sanctum and vimana
Quadrangular prakara and low perimeter ranges
special_features: Sculpted gopura with granite passage and ochre stucco tiers
Ganesha lintel image, doorway guardians and silver-clad Devi reliefs
renovation_history: The Development Authority attributes the 1827 repairs and entrance gopura to Krishnaraja Wodeyar III.
